title: Climate TRACE March 2026 release tracks global emissions through Jan 2026
snippet: Climate TRACE Release 5.5.0 (March 2026) — Monthly emissions data through January 2026 across 745M sources, 300+ satellites, 11000+ sensors. Plumes tool visualizes daily PM2.5 from 9560 industrial/power facilities in 2572 cities. 2025 review: oil/gas sector emissions reached new highs.
